gate_objections: part 1 (pages 1-18): B31 check hint is written in Spanish ('La edad al empezar a ahorrar...'), while the rest of the inventory is English; it must be in the questionnaire language.

part 1 (pages 1-18): B31 codes Don't know/Refused as 1 and 2, which collide with real age values 1 and 2 (an age of 1 or 2 years is a valid answer). The check predicate '@[B31] in [1, 2] or ...' therefore skips validation for real ages. The source prints no codes for B31, so these codes are invented.

part 1 (pages 1-18): B8 and B9: jumps 'B8 >= 1 -> B20' and 'B9 >= 34 -> B20' are fine, but B9's code values (34-66) and B8's (1-33) are taken from the printed layout. Rows 'A2 No' and the PMK block are listed, yet the A2 'No' jump is split into two jumps (A2 -> PMK First Name and 'PMK Sex -> END'). The END jump is not printed in the source and is invented.

part 1 (pages 1-18): The jump 'Selection 9 Age -> CHILD 1 First Name' is invented as a leaving point; the source routes from A3 (go to CHILD 1... then Section B). Also A3 is modelled as a question with invented codes (1: 01-03 children, 2: 04 or more) although it is an interviewer check item, and the same applies to the B4, B26, B30, B39, B44, C4 check items with invented codes.

part 1 (pages 1-18): The 'Selection N' rows 5-9 carry conditions such as '@[A1] >= 5' with source_text 'Row 5 applies when there are 5 or more children'. This is invented text not in the source. Row 1-4 conditions use A1 >= 4 which is also not printed per row.

part 1 (pages 1-18): The B37 jump to B42 ('all answered No, DK or Refused') is attached to B37d, but B38 (investment types) follows B37 and is printed before B39; fine, but B38 has no condition recorded while B37's skip rule implies B38 is asked only if at least one of B37a-d is Yes. The 'ask only if' condition for B38 is missing.

part 1 (pages 1-18): B5 and B6 conditions are inconsistent with the B4 jumps: B6 is conditioned on '@[CHILD 1 Age] >= 5', but a 9+ child goes to B5 and not B6 (the source routes to B5 only; what follows B5 is not printed in the source). B5 -> next-question flow is not recorded as a jump. The same applies to C5/C6.

part 1 (pages 1-18): Scope omits the Language block 'English' option properly but lists the 'Language' question with a single code '01 — English' labelled with its code number, and the code value is 1 instead of the printed 01. Minor label annotation issue.

part 1 (pages 1-18): Missing jumps: B12-B19 etc. have none, which is fine, but B25 and B28 sequences are fine; the printed 'Go to B20 (page 11)' arrows on B7 are mapped to options 1 and 2 by inference, which the builder admits is a guess; this attachment should be flagged rather than recorded as fact.

part 2 (pages 19-37): D21: the source prints no id for the cost question after D20, and the inventory invents 'D21'. The 'source_id' must be exactly as printed, so list it without an invented id or in the way the host expects for unlabelled items.

part 2 (pages 19-37): D1 is printed once but split into invented ids D1a, D1b, D1c and D1d. The D1a text also carries builder commentary ('id D1a: the source prints one D1…') and D1d carries '(printed without an id, within D1)'. These are not verbatim wording. Keep the printed id D1 and the wording clean.
part 2 (pages 19-37): C41a: the text begins with 'C41. Which types of RESPs are being used?', which copies the id into the wording. The question stem should not contain the printed id.

part 2 (pages 19-37): Jump from C23 to C25a uses the condition '@[C23] >= 0'. C23 also has Don't know and Refused outcomes, and the source's 'Go to C25 (page 26)' is unconditional. Under this condition those answers get no jump, so the condition does not match the printed routing.
